about.title: About AgriDarshak
about.subtitle: An AI-based Smart Agriculture Assistance System that empowers farmers to make data-driven decisions using Machine Learning, real-time meteorological feeds, and agronomic intelligence.
about.purposeDesc: To empower Indian farmers with accessible, actionable, and hyper-local AI insights for soil health, crop selection, weather protection, market intelligence, and plant disease management.
about.helpPoint1: Precision NPK and pH soil health diagnostics with organic fertilizer recommendations
about.helpPoint2: Intelligent multi-factor crop selection based on soil characteristics, weather, and market demand
about.helpPoint3: Real-time weather tracking with proactive climate distress and rain alerts
about.helpPoint4: Live mandi price intelligence with upward/downward price trend analysis
about.helpPoint5: Instant leaf disease diagnostics powered by MobileNetV2 deep learning model
about.helpPoint6: Soil classification from photo uploads or manual parameter entry
about.helpPoint7: Full native language interface in Odia, Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, Bengali, Gujarati, Marathi, and English
about.techDesc: React, Vite, FastAPI, PyTorch (MobileNetV2), Google Gemini 2.5 Flash, Open-Meteo Weather API, data.gov.in Mandi API, SQLite/PostgreSQL.
about.supportDesc: Dedicated to empowering the farming community. Developed with ground feedback from agricultural research centers in Odisha.

recommendation.clearDrainage: Clear drainage channels and secure low-lying field bunds before heavy rainfall.
recommendation.eveningIrrigation: Schedule light evening irrigation and apply organic mulching to prevent moisture loss.
recommendation.stakeCrops: Provide staking support for tall crops and delay foliar spraying until winds subside.
recommendation.monitorWeather: Monitor field conditions closely for impending adverse weather shifts.
recommendation.accelerateHarvest: Accelerate harvesting of mature crop stands before weather conditions deteriorate.
recommendation.replenishIrrigation: Replenish scheduled irrigation to prevent soil moisture stress.
recommendation.inspectGrowth: Inspect crop vegetative progress and ensure timely agronomic care.
recommendation.isolateInfected: Prune and isolate infected plant leaves to prevent secondary disease spread.
recommendation.applyBioFungicide: Apply preventive neem oil (5ml/L) or bio-fungicide during evening hours.
recommendation.staggeredSelling: Consider staggered selling or check nearby district APMC mandis for higher prevailing rates.
recommendation.dryAndGrade: Ensure proper post-harvest crop drying and grading to avoid mandi quality price deductions.
recommendation.applyLime: Apply agricultural lime (to raise acidic pH) or gypsum (for alkaline soil) during land prep.
recommendation.incorporateManure: Incorporate well-rotted farmyard manure (FYM) to enhance nutrient retention and soil structure.
recommendation.regularScouting: Maintain regular crop scouting and scheduled irrigation.
recommendation.trackAlerts: Track local weather alerts and daily mandi prices on the dashboard.

distressIndex.title: Farmer Distress Index
distressIndex.subtitle: Agricultural Early-Warning Score
distressIndex.whyScoreTitle: Why this Score? Inspect Risk Factors
distressIndex.whyScoreSubtitle: Transparent breakdown of what is happening, why it matters, and recommended action.

whyMattersExplanations.weather: Erratic precipitation, extreme temperatures, or high wind gusts can cause crop lodging, flower drop, or severe moisture stress.
whyMattersExplanations.disease: Active pathogens or high relative humidity accelerate fungal and bacterial spore germination, leading to significant foliar biomass loss.
whyMattersExplanations.market: Sudden APMC yard price drops or unfavorable price momentum directly erode profit margins on pending harvest batches.
whyMattersExplanations.crop: Pre-harvest exposure or delayed stage management increases post-maturity shattering, pest vulnerability, and yield penalties.
whyMattersExplanations.soil: Nutrient imbalances (NPK) or suboptimal pH restrict plant root nutrient uptake, leading to stunted vegetative vigor.
whyMattersExplanations.context: Unresolved urgent alerts or delayed farm management responses compound field-level vulnerabilities over time.
